title: Annotatio VI §.IV close: other Fathers same; Picherellus on HOC — stop before §.V Classis III
pass_a_gloss: Picherellus at the cited place grants like interpretation to the remaining Fathers’ figured sentences of this kind, from p. 182 mid to the end of his third Chapter — at whose beginning he exposits what the Pronoun THIS demonstrates in Christ’s saying, This is my body, from p. 163.
pass_b_english: Picherellus reads the other Fathers’ figured lines the same way through the end of his third chapter.
He also opens what THIS points to in “This is my body” (from p. 163). Stop §.IV before §.V (Classis III Rationativa).
source_text: Reliquorum Patrum figuratas hujusmodi sententias, simili interpretatione donat Picherellus loc. cit., à pag. 182. in med. ad finem usque Capitis sui tertii, in cujus initio exponit, quid Pronomen HOC, in dicto Christi, Hoc est corpus meum, demonstret, à pag. 163.
